headers.//: Media in public/ ships under stable, non-fingerprinted names, so Vercel's default (max-age=0, must-revalidate) makes every repeat visit re-download the video. A day of freshness plus a month of stale-while-revalidate keeps return visits instant while still letting a swapped file propagate within a day. Not 'immutable' precisely because the names are stable — a re-encoded cover reuses its filename.
